holdout.rule: JevGym seeds < 1000 are evaluation/pilot seeds (E2: 0..199) and never appear here; no BFCL or When2Call TEST item is included

notes.purpose: API-free starter data for the training programme (docs/TRAINING_AGENT_BRIEF.md). Big enough to validate every stage end to end and to run first SFT / calibration experiments; NOT the full training set (that is 00_harvest.sh on >= 1000 training-seed episodes + xLAM, plus Jev teacher labels).
notes.regenerate: bash scripts/train/make_data_v0.sh   (SKIP_EPISODES=1 reuses runs/dev; every API step is cached or resumable)

files.train.jsonl / dev.jsonl: JevGym agentic decisions with ORACLE GOLD one-hot targets (tool_select Choice, tool_params Choice, stop Noul gate), split by task (dev = 15% of tasks). Format: src/jevharness/training/data.py.
train.jsonl with soft targets q = 0.3*gold + 0.7*p_teacher from the STAND-IN teacher (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite verbalised distribution, teacher_label.py; consensus != gold keeps the gold one-hot: meta.label_source = gold, teacher_outcome = gold_mismatch). Replace / complement with Jev labels: TEACHERS='jev=jev-openrouter;lite=gemini-lite' bash scripts/train/20_teacher_soft.sh.
files.replay_when2call.jsonl.gz / dev_when2cal: When2Call TRAIN split (SFT file) as 4-way decisions in the When2Call test format. Only request_for_info / cannot_answer occur (the SFT file has no call / direct rows; label rule: assistant turn contains '?' -> request_for_info). Mix with xLAM call items (harvest --xlam adds When2Call-format 'call' items) before relying on it for E1 When2Call.
files.mc_standin.jsonl: Counterfactual Q-hat for a few v1 tool_select states (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite executor, T=0.7, K=3 alternatives x M=2 rollouts): a pipeline / sanity set for stages 40/50/55, too small for results.
files.trajectories/<run>/{experiment.yaml, sha: the raw harness trajectories (input of harvest.py and mc_rollouts.py; gunzip for mc_rollouts). experiment.yaml holds the resolved suite and models.
files.dev_teacher_standin.summary.json: metrics of the stand-in teacher (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite) on dev.jsonl vs gold (teachers.lite.acc / nll / ece): the reference of the T3 gate 'R3 dev acc >= 90% of the teacher's'. dev.jsonl itself stays gold.

models.system2: gemini-3.5-flash (temperature 0, reasoning_effort minimal): it acted in every episode (LLM-only behaviour)
models.system1_shadow: gemini-3.5-flash-lite verbalised distribution (STAND-IN for Jev; logged in meta.logged.s1_value / s1_conf)

notes.holdout: JevGym seeds: v2 10000..10029, v1 12000..12059; evaluation seeds 0..199 and dev seeds 5000+ never used. No BFCL item and no When2Call TEST item.
known_limits: Gemini 3.5 Flash is at ceiling on JevGym (every episode succeeds), so states are on-policy for a strong System-2 and contain few recovery states; the S1 stand-in's mistakes are logged (meta.logged) but not acted on.
tool_select decisions with 69 options (v2 suite) keep the gold + 51 seeded random others (harvest --max-options 52); served, a 69-option Choice goes through the 52-chunk knockout.
When2Call replay has two of four classes (see above).

licenses.JevGym data: ours (synthetic environment, generated by this repository)

cost_estimates.mc_standin.jsonl: NOT in cost_usd: mc_rollouts.py had no Ledger summary when v0 was generated (it now writes <out>.summary.json). Re-measured on 4 of its 24 states with the fixed code: $0.00274 per rollout episode (Flash-Lite executor) -> ~ $0.39 for the 24 x 3 x 2 = 144 episodes.
cost_estimates.budget_probes: a 60-decision teacher probe ($0.046) and the 4-state MC re-measurement ($0.066) are not part of the released files
cost_estimates.total_spent_generating_v0_usd: ~ 5.17 (MANIFEST cost_usd.total + the MC estimate + the two probes)
